chunks: Whatever is in it from Hafs ibn Salim, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Hafs Abu Wallad ibn Salim al-Kufi

key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: A nisbah indicating association with Kūfah.
key_terms.حَفْصِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ: A narrator whose transmission route is being identified here.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression indicating direct reporting through a sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مَوْلًى: A freed servant or client affiliated with a tribe or household.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ḥafṣ ibn Sālim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which al-Ṣadūq transmits reports from Ḥafṣ ibn Sālim in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a chain-identification note, preserving the transmission pathway and a brief biographical detail about Ḥafṣ Abū Wallād ibn Sālim al-Kūfī.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Hafs ibn Salim has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Hafs Abu Wallad ibn Salim Al-Kufi,
